definitions.explanation: Being the exact thing or equal in value or quality.

examples.japanese: {同|おな}じ{本|ほん}を{持|も}っている。
{私|わたし}たちは{同|おな}じ{学校|がっこう}です。
examples.english: We go to the same school.

examples.japanese: これとそれは{同|おな}じだ。
examples.english: This and that are the same.

notes:
{同|おな}じ means 'same' or 'identical.' It has unusual grammar—acting as both pre-noun adjectival and predicate.

GRAMMAR PATTERNS:
- {同|おな}じ + noun: the same ~ ({同|おな}じ{本|ほん})
- 〜と{同|おな}じ: same as ~ (AとBは{同|おな}じだ)
- 〜と{同|おな}じように: in the same way as ~
- {同|おな}じく: likewise, similarly (adverb)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {同|おな}じ{年|とし}: same age
- {同|おな}じ{時間|じかん}: same time
- {同|おな}じ{意見|いけん}: same opinion

GRAMMAR NOTE:
{同|おな}じ is grammatically unusual—it modifies nouns directly (like a pre-noun adjectival) but also works as a predicate ({同|おな}じだ).

CONTRAST:
- {違|ちが}う: different (antonym)
- {似|に}ている: similar (not identical)
